original_ai_output.title_zh: 巴耶尔萨州政府否认宁贝-布拉斯桥坍塌传言，称道路工程已完成85%
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 巴耶尔萨州政府否认社交媒体上关于宁贝-布拉斯公路项目桥梁存在结构缺陷或坍塌的说法，称施工按批准的设计推进。州政府表示，这条21公里公路项目一期已完成约85%，预计2027年第一季度可交付启用。工程与基础设施专员及信息专员在项目巡查期间作出上述表态。

key_facts.fact: 巴耶尔萨州政府否认宁贝-布拉斯公路桥梁坍塌的社交媒体传言
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Bayelsa State Government has dismissed reports circulating on social media alleging a structural defect or collapse of a bridge along the ongoing Nembe-Brass road project

key_facts.fact: 州政府称21公里公路项目一期已完成约85%
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the first phase of the 21-kilometre road project was about 85 per cent complete

key_facts.fact: 州政府预计该公路将于2027年第一季度交付启用
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: expressing confidence that the road would be ready for commissioning in the first quarter of 2027

key_facts.fact: 工程与基础设施专员及信息专员在项目巡查期间作出上述表态
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Commissioners for Works and Infrastructure, Moses Teibowei, and his Information, Orientation and Strategy counterpart, Ebiuwou Koku-Obiyai, stated this on Saturday during an inspection tour
